# GitHub automation

Repository checks live here. GitHub runs them when changes are pushed or proposed for review, so broken builds and tests are caught before integration.

See [workflows](workflows/README.md) for what runs.

[AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) contains the development guide; [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) points to that same guide. They are development-tool instructions, separate from the [runtime researcher](../assistant/README.md). Tools that only auto-discover root-level instruction files must be pointed here explicitly.
